comparison.objective: Produce a sound TIG bead along an L-shaped seam.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually coordinate torch travel, standoff, heat dwell, and filler-rod dabs.
comparison.success_condition: All seam segments meet bead and defect criteria without contamination or burn-through, with tools returned and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Continuous bimanual welding and thermal-process control are materially different from hex-tool manipulation and damper-response tuning.
